# Send an investor update

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

On the company's agreed investor reporting cadence or when a material update is due. A fact-checked update delivered to the authorized investor group, with requests and follow-up owned.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Confirm the audience and reporting commitments

agent-runnable


List current investor contacts, contractual information rights, agreed cadence and confidentiality restrictions. Separate the broad investor update from board-only, lender or legally sensitive reporting.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Assemble reconciled metrics and material developments

agent-runnable


Collect cash, runway, revenue, customer, hiring and product evidence for the reporting period. Define metrics consistently, flag estimates and reconcile changes from previous reports.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Draft the update and specific requests

agent-runnable


Summarize progress against prior commitments, setbacks, risks and the next priorities. State concrete help requests and distinguish a management forecast from a committed result or financing offer.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve the content and recipients

human · human approval required


The founder and designated finance or legal reviewer check accuracy, material omissions, confidentiality and recipient permissions. Resolve sensitive issues through the appropriate governance process before distribution.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Deliver the approved update and assign responses

human · human approval required


Send the approved version through the agreed channel and retain the recipient list privately. Track introductions, questions and commitments with owners rather than treating delivery as completion of the follow-up work.

- Verify: A fact-checked update delivered to the authorized investor group, with requests and follow-up owned.
- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)
